name: Predictive Safe Click
description: Experimental cube-only predictive jump buffer. Delays early clicks up to N physics ticks; if none is predicted safe, fires at the limit.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Use only on test levels first. Prediction is approximate.

max-delay.name: Maximum buffering ticks
max-delay.description: At 240 TPS, four ticks are about 16.7 milliseconds.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostic log
diagnostics.description: Log buffered and injected jumps to the Geode log file.

margin.name: Collision margin
margin.description: Extra world units around the modeled cube rectangle.
